name: Band Concentration Curl
steps: Sit on a bench with your feet apart, pin a resistance band under one foot, and grip the free end in that same hand.
Lean slightly forward and press the back of your working upper arm firmly against your inner thigh.
Curl your hand smoothly upward toward your shoulder while keeping your upper arm stationary.
Lower your hand slowly under tension back to near full extension, then switch sides after finishing one arm.
tips: Keep the back of your upper arm anchored against your thigh rather than swinging your elbow.
Adjust how far along the band you grip so there is light tension even at the bottom.
